name: 维兰达
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3189
who: Veranda, a dragonkin of the thinnest blood, a legend who has looked thirty for thousands of years: about 174 cm, tall and lean. Straight steel-blue hair cut at the shoulder, two small blue-green scales at the temples, pale gold vertical-slit pupils that look at people for a long time, a calm and unhurried gaze. Fair skin. She goes barefoot, the soles of her feet hardened with a thick callus. On her back she carries a single blue-and-gold dragon scale as tall as half a person, a ring of small unreadable script around its rim. She never speaks first and waits for the other to finish; sits down rather than stands over anyone. Afraid of dogs. Her hair hangs perfectly straight and smooth to the shoulder, not wavy or curled.
face: FACE, as in the references: calm, long-lidded eyes with pale gold vertical-slit pupils, a quiet closed mouth, two small blue-green scales at the temples; a thirty-year-old's composed face, no wrinkles. The pupils are narrow VERTICAL slits, a thin dark upright line in the middle of each pale gold iris like a lizard's eye, drawn plainly as slits in every panel and in every one of the nine expressions, never round.
build: 174 cm, tall and lean: long arms and legs, level shoulders, a B-cup, a slim waist and narrow hips.
palette: steel blue, blue-green scale, pale gold, worn grey linen, ink black
casual: A long washed-out grey linen robe closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves with ink-stained cuffs, an empty cloth bag for pen and ink at the belt, no shoes at all; across her back, hung from a wide strap, the single blue-and-gold dragon scale as tall as half a person. She stands quietly with her hands loose, as if about to sit down.
private: Sitting on the ground on a folded blanket, the back scale laid beside her: the same grey linen robe with the sleeves pushed up, bare feet tucked under her, a wooden bowl of plain porridge in both hands, listening with her head slightly tilted.
battle: Walking out alone beyond the wall to speak to a war god: the grey linen robe belted tight with a plain cord, leather bracers on the forearms, bare feet, the large scale on her back; no weapon, both hands open and empty at her sides, her pale gold eyes level and unafraid.
formal: At a clan gathering of the dragon-kin: a wide-sleeved coat of slate blue wool open over a grey linen under-robe, a narrow silver belt, ink-stained cuffs left unwashed, small silver thread running along the hems like scale lines that shimmer, the blue-and-gold scale worn on her back on a silvered strap; still barefoot, hands folded in front, a composed, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale gold slit pupils resting on the viewer with long, patient attention, lips closed. Cool grey dawn light from the left with a faint blue-gold glint off the edge of the scale behind her shoulder. Foreground blur: drifting ash and a few blurred blades of dry grass.

name: 凯兰
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3223
who: Kailan, a human runner who has looked thirty-one ever since he became a legend, with the boyish face and bright, quick manner of a much younger man, though clearly a grown man: about 173 cm, slim and wiry, light on his feet. Messy honey-coloured short hair, a long thin braid hanging from the nape, amber eyes that crinkle shut when he smiles, a small old scar through the outer end of the left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when they face us). Fair skin. A pair of soft shoes burnt through at the soles hangs from his belt, kept though he wears new ones. Talkative, warm, always looking toward the wind first and then at people's feet. The small old pale scar cutting through the outer end of the left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is drawn clearly in every panel and in the portrait: a short pale line that breaks the brow hair, with the fringe kept clear of that eyebrow.
build: 173 cm, slim and wiry, a runner's long calves and narrow shoulders.
palette: honey gold, amber, sun-faded green, warm brown leather, soot grey
casual: A runner's clothes: a short belted tunic of faded green wool with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, close-fitting dark trousers tucked into new soft leather shoes, a leather wrist-strap on each wrist, a small pouch at the back of the belt; hanging from the belt on a cord, the old pair of soft shoes with burnt-out soles. He stands on the balls of his feet with a bright grin, one hand lifted as if to wave.
private: Sitting on a stone wall with his legs swinging: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the collar open, plain trousers, the new shoes off beside him and the burnt shoes held up in one hand as he tells the story, an animated, laughing look.
battle: Running ahead of the danger: the green tunic cinched tight with a belt, leather bracers and knee wraps, the old burnt shoes tied at his belt, no weapon. Bright eyes, the mouth open to shout a warning.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: caught mid-stride in a full sprint on the toes, one arm swinging forward and the other cupped beside his mouth to shout, the braid streaming behind him, a fierce, urgent but still laughing look.
formal: At a village feast: a clean dark-green wool jerkin with a laced front over a pale linen shirt, leather wrist-straps, the nape braid tied with a new ribbon, the new shoes polished, a bright tin charm at the belt that chirps faintly when he moves; the burnt shoes still at his belt. He stands with a cheerful, slightly embarrassed grin.
art: A close portrait from slightly low, the amber eyes crinkled in a warm laugh, the honey hair tousled by wind and the thin nape braid blowing across his shoulder. Warm low gold sun from the right, rim-lighting the hair. Foreground blur: flying wheat chaff and blades of grass streaking past.

name: 狄昂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3239
who: Dion, a human boy of the islands, a legend who has looked seventeen ever since: about 172 cm, slim, upright and stiff-backed, wholly covered by his clothes. Black hair that shows a gold sheen in the rain, ruffled by sea wind, deep stormy slate-blue eyes like the sky before a thunderstorm, a small old scar under the chin. Fair skin. On his back he carries a round bronze shield polished like a still lake, which reflects the sky and others but never his own face, a pair of closed stone eyes set in its boss. Few words, hard, proud, never looks back. Sits high up watching storms at night. His hair is one even black all over, with nothing more than a faint warm gold gloss on the lit strands; there is no pale, grey, blond or lighter-coloured streak or lock anywhere in it, in any panel.
palette: storm slate blue, polished bronze, wet black with a gold sheen, sail-cloth grey
casual: An island boy's clothes: a long-sleeved sail-cloth tunic to the knee, belted with a rope, long dark trousers, laced sea boots, a short grey cloak over both shoulders; on his back the round bronze shield, its polished face turned outward, the closed stone eyes in the centre. He stands very straight, chin up, the arms at his sides.
private: Sitting on a high rock at dusk watching the sky: a long-sleeved dark wool jersey closed to the throat, plain long trousers, boots, the shield propped beside him; he does not look at the viewer but at the clouds, a stern, calm look.
battle: Walking backwards toward danger: the sail-cloth tunic under a boiled-leather jerkin, leather bracers, the short cloak, the bronze shield held in front of him at his chest, its polished face toward him so that he looks only into it; his body turned away, his mouth set tight, the brow drawn together.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: he stands side-on with his face turned away from the foe, holding the large round bronze shield up in both hands in front of his chest, steady and braced, the mouth closed, a hard, determined look.
formal: At a harbour memorial: a dark navy sailcloth coat open over a white linen shirt with a plain round neck, a rope belt, a short grey sea-cloak clasped at one shoulder with a shell pin, polished boots, the bronze shield worn on his back with its face freshly polished, a faint water-ripple pattern moving along the cloak's edge. He stands stiffly, hands at his sides, a proud, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait in a storm, the face a little turned, the slate-blue eyes serious and wide open, the mouth closed. Cold storm light from the left, rain streaking down, a faint gold sheen in the wet black hair. Foreground blur: raindrops and a pale flash of lightning far off.

name: 艾德蒙德·长笛
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3256
who: Edmund Flute, a human court musician who has looked forty-six since he became a legend, a man who has never fought: about 184 cm, tall and thin. Neatly trimmed deep blue-black hair with a few white strands, lake-blue eyes that often look to the side as if listening to someone beside him, a courteous, remote, rarely smiling face. Fair skin. At his belt hangs a small bone vial holding a pinch of grey-white sand that does not fall even when the vial is turned over. Polite, light-voiced, calls everyone sir or madam; cooks for two out of habit. He is plainly a man of forty-six, not a youth: fine lines at the outer corners of the eyes and beside the mouth, a faint crease across the brow, slightly hollowed cheeks, a composed and unsmiling mouth; the white in his blue-black hair is only a few thin scattered strands at the temples, not one thick white lock. There is NO white streak, lock, highlight or patch anywhere in his hair, in any panel, the portrait or the expressions: from any distance the hair reads as solid deep blue-black, and the only white is four or five single hairs, each as thin as a thread, scattered at the temples and almost invisible. His age shows in the face, not in the hair.
build: 184 cm, tall and thin, long-fingered hands, narrow shoulders and a slight stoop.
palette: deep lake blue, blue-black, bone white, grey wool, a little pale silver
casual: The court musician's dress he still wears: a long robe of deep blue wool closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the cuffs embroidered in pale silver with a ring of small lake waves, a plain grey wool travelling coat over it, polished black boots; at the belt the small bone vial of grey-white sand. He stands with his head slightly turned and a space left at his side, as if for someone else.
private: At home by the lake in the evening: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a dark waistcoat, plain trousers and soft house shoes, the bone vial on a cord at his waist; he holds two plain bowls, one in each hand, as if about to set them down for two people, a quiet, faintly wistful look.
battle: Walking into a surrounded camp without a weapon: the grey travelling coat over the deep blue robe, leather gloves, the bone vial at his belt, both hands empty at his sides; calm, upright, and smiling slightly.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: he walks forward unhurried with both hands open and empty at his sides, the head slightly turned as if to glance at the empty space beside him, a faint calm smile, no weapon at all.
formal: At the palace: a court musician's deep blue silk-wool coat worn open over a pale silver-embroidered waistcoat, lake-wave embroidery at the cuffs and hem, a narrow white sash, soft black boots, the bone vial at the belt, thin silver threads in the embroidery that ripple like water. He stands very straight, hands folded, a formal, reserved look.
art: A portrait, the face turned a little aside, the lake-blue eyes looking past the viewer to something quietly beside them, the lips just parted in a courteous half-smile. Soft cool blue lakeside light from behind, the white strands in his hair catching it. Foreground blur: a soft haze, a few drifting white petals.

name: 希波诺
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3272
who: Hipono, a blind human horseman who has looked twenty-one ever since he became a legend: about 178 cm, lean, his left leg badly set. Long unkempt hair, half pale gold and half white, falling past the shoulders, nobody ties it for him. His eyes are covered by a grey cloth tied round the head; under it lie two old scars, so no eyes are shown. Fair skin. He leans on a crutch of thornwood in his left hand; a bowstring is wound round his left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us); in his right hand (on the viewer's left) he grips a white feather longer than his arm that keeps floating upward. Quiet, stubborn, avoids people, speaks of the sky as above. His left leg (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is visibly badly set: shorter than the right, bent at the knee and turned a little inward, so that he stands with his weight on the right leg and the crutch and the left foot only rests on the ground; the crooked leg is drawn plainly in every panel.
build: 178 cm, lean and sinewy, a rider's narrow frame, the left leg shorter and bent.
palette: pale gold and white hair, grey blindfold cloth, thornwood brown, pasture green, bone white
casual: A plain pasture rider's clothes, worn and unbrushed: a long brown wool tunic to the knees belted at the waist, close dark trousers, scuffed riding boots, a threadbare green-grey cloak; the grey cloth over the eyes, the thornwood crutch under the left arm, the bowstring on the left wrist, the white feather held in the right fist.
private: Sitting on a rock by the roadside with the crutch across his knees: the brown tunic with the sleeves pushed up, the cloak folded under him, a flat loaf and a cup of water that someone left on a stone beside him; the white feather tucked into his belt for once, his face tilted listening to the wind.
battle: Riding out in front of the guns: a brown leather riding jerkin over the tunic, leather bracers, the cloak thrown back, the grey blindfold, the bowstring on the left wrist; the thornwood crutch gone, the white feather raised in his right fist and pulling upward.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced on his good leg with the crooked left leg set back, the face lifted toward the sky and the blindfold turned to the wind, the right fist raised with the long white feather rising straight up out of it, a tense, resolute look with the mouth closed.
formal: Invited to a feast and keeping a guest's manners: a clean long dark green wool coat closed with buttons, a white shirt collar, the hair brushed back and tied with a plain cord, the grey blindfold freshly washed, the crutch and the white feather still in his hands. He stands very correctly, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face tilted up, the grey blindfold across the eyes, the lips pressed together. A long white feather floats upward beside his cheek. Cold high white light from above. Foreground blur: drifting white feather fluff and pale cloud streaks.

name: 茵妮
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3410
who: Inny, a human woman who carries the abandoned out of battles on her back, a legend who has looked twenty-five or twenty-six ever since: short at about 158 cm, broad-shouldered, with a slight stoop in the lower back from carrying so many. Frost-white short hair that she cut herself with a knife, uneven lengths. Amber eyes that narrow when she looks far, as if counting birds crossing the sky. Fair skin. Two old scars run from each shoulder blade to the waist, always hidden under her clothes. Curt, tough, quick with her hands, complains the person on her back is heavy and never lets go.
build: 158 cm, short and strong: broad shoulders and a thick, powerful back, a small bust, a firm waist and sturdy legs.
palette: frost white, amber, weathered grey-brown cloak, bone white, dull rope grey
casual: A much-mended old cloak that has been altered many times, in faded grey-brown wool with patches of other colours, clasped at the throat; under it a plain long-sleeved tunic, belted trousers and worn boots; on her back a carrying frame she wove herself out of withes and rope, empty, and a small canvas pack in which lies a very small white bone crown (not worn). She stands with her shoulders squared and her hands on the frame straps, squinting into the distance.
private: Resting by a low fire with the frame set down: the old cloak off and folded under her, a thick long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, soft boots; she holds a tin cup and watches a flock of birds go south, the small bone crown set carefully on the folded cloak beside her, an off-guard, tired look.
battle: Going into a collapsing flank to bring people out: the old cloak thrown back, a worn leather jerkin and bracers over the tunic, the woven carrying frame strapped tight on her back, a rope coiled over one shoulder; no weapon, her arms free and reaching, her teeth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: bent forward under the carrying frame with her arms stretched out in front to pull someone up, the weight set on her strong legs, the brows drawn together and the jaw set, a fierce, determined look.
formal: She refuses finery: the same old cloak, brushed and re-sewn at the hem, over a clean dark wool dress with long sleeves, the carrying frame left at the door; she stands with her feet apart and her hands folded in front, awkward but upright, the small bone crown still unworn in the pack at her side.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly over her shoulder, the amber eyes narrowed as if counting birds, the lips pressed together in a worn, tough look. Pale grey smoky daylight with a cold amber glow from behind. Foreground blur: drifting smoke and the strap of the carrying frame near the lens.

name: 珂伦娜
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3466
who: Corenna, a deep-tide serpent demon woman, a legend who has looked early forty for centuries: about 188 cm, tall and strong. She has four arms: the upper pair works and gestures, the lower pair is always folded still against her chest. Skin the blue-grey of rock at low tide, a layer of fine scales on the forearms and the sides of the neck, always salt-crusted. Dark green hair in one thick braid, wet and ropy like kelp. Pale salt-water eyes that never blink. No horns. At her waist hangs a rolled tide chart; on her back a bone sword she has not yet ground straight. Slow, patient, devout.
build: 188 cm, tall and powerfully built: broad shoulders, long strong arms, a C-cup, a firm waist and long legs.
palette: low-tide blue-grey, kelp dark green, salt white, bone, wet slate
casual: A sleeveless short tunic woven of sea-fibre with kelp threads that does not rot in water, cut with four armholes for her four arms, closed down the front with buttons, a leather belt with the rolled tide chart hung from it, dark trousers rolled to the shin and bare feet; on her back the bone sword in a plain sheath. The upper hands rest at her sides, the lower pair is folded against her chest.
private: Standing in shallow salt water at dusk: a loose undyed sea-fibre shirt with four sleeves pushed up, no belt or sword, the lower pair of arms folded; she reads the water's edge, the tide chart unrolled in one upper hand, a patient, level look.
battle: Holding a salt circle round a bastion: the sea-fibre tunic under a light leather harness, the bone sword drawn in the upper right hand, the upper left hand raised palm-out as if drawing the sea up; the lower pair stays folded still against her chest; wet salt on the arms.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing firm and still with the bone sword held point-down in the upper right hand and the upper left hand lifted palm-out, the lower pair of arms folded against her chest, an unblinking, patient look.
formal: At a gathering of her clan: a long salt-grey gown of sea-fibre to the ankles with four sleeves, kelp-green piping and a pearl-white shell clasp at the collar, the braid wound up on her head and pinned with a bone comb, the tide chart on its cord at the waist. She stands upright, the four hands folded in pairs, a composed, steady look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face level and unblinking, the pale salt-water eyes looking straight at the viewer with calm patience, the lips closed; the lower pair of hands is folded against her chest at the frame's edge. Cold blue-grey light off water from one side. Foreground blur: flying salt spray and white salt crystals.

name: 亨德里克·费尔曼
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:3521
who: Hendrik Fairman, a human gate commander of the seventh bastion, sixty-three: about 186 cm, tall, with a slight stoop. Short white-grey hair cropped close to the scalp, a nose and cheeks reddened by years of sea wind, pale faded blue eyes that have watched distant lights all his life and squint to read close text. Fair skin. The right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us) is missing its ring and little fingers, taken by a broken chain when he was nineteen. A brass whistle hangs at his belt, once used on a chain-boat. Quiet, counts things aloud before speaking, calls the wounded passengers waiting for a boat; remembers whose boots are worn. The right hand (on the viewer's left when he faces us) has ONLY three digits: the thumb, the index finger and the middle finger; the ring finger and the little finger are gone down to the knuckle, leaving a flat stump on the outer side of the hand, and this three-fingered hand is drawn clearly in every panel, including when the hands are folded or raised.
face: FACE, as in the references: an aged face, deep weather lines at the eyes and mouth, a reddened nose and cheeks, pale faded blue eyes narrowed from long watching, short white-grey stubble-cropped hair.
build: 186 cm, tall and spare, a stoop in the shoulders, big weathered hands.
palette: sea-wind red, faded pale blue, salt-stained grey, brass, dull leather brown
casual: A salt-stained grey wool coat closed down the front with buttons over a thick dark sweater, a thick belt with a brass whistle, sturdy boots; he is counting small lights on a chain across the water. The right hand is missing its ring and little fingers. A calm, patient look.
private: Sitting in the gate passage at night with his back to the wall: the grey coat unbuttoned, a thick wool scarf, sleeves pushed up, a lantern at his feet and a pair of new boots in his lap that he is lacing for somebody else, a tired, kind look.
battle: On the wall at dusk: a worn leather brigandine over the grey coat, a leather cap with ear flaps, the brass whistle at the belt, a short plain sword at his hip, a shuttered lantern in his left hand; he is counting lights on the chain, his back slightly stooped, a steady, watchful look.
formal: On the day of mustering: a clean grey wool coat brushed and pressed, a faded blue sash across the chest, the brass whistle polished, the white-grey hair combed flat. He stands upright with his hands at his sides, the missing fingers showing, a calm, formal look.
art: A close portrait, the face turned toward a far light just out of frame, the faded blue eyes narrowed and patient, the weathered red cheeks and nose lit by the lantern. Cold grey sea twilight behind, warm lantern glow from low on the left. Foreground blur: drifting sea mist and small distant lights in a line.
